description: WRITE: add an ingredient line to a recipe, by unit and quantity (the unit must be one the ingredient offers, e.g. "1 cup" or "1 gram"; see units_and_grams from recipal_get_recipe_ingredient or valid_units from recipal_get_ingredient) or directly by total_grams (overrides unit and quantity). Changes the recipe's nutrition, label and cost. POST /recipes/{id}/recipe_ingredients.

total_grams.description: Weight in grams; overrides unit and quantity.

unit.description: Unit of the ingredient (default: its first unit).

waste.description: Percent of the ingredient that does not go into the product (0-100). Costed in full, excluded from nutrition.

name: recipal_add_recipe_ingredient
title: Add ingredient to recipe

description: WRITE: create a custom ingredient (private to your account) with its nutrition facts. For a food ingredient give nutrition_unit and nutrition_quantity (the serving the nutrients are entered for, e.g. 1 cup; for units beyond gram/oz/lb/kg add them in measures first) and all required nutrients. food and non_food cannot be changed later. Non-food items: set food=false and non_food to labor, packaging, safety, other_hourly or other_fixed. POST /ingredients.

allergens.description: Allergens by name, e.g. {"Milk": true, "Almond": true, "other-shellfish": "Oyster"}. Standard names: Wheat, Peanuts, Soy, Sesame, Mustard, Sulfites, Milk (Goat milk, Sheep milk), Egg (Duck egg, Quail egg), Fish (Tuna, Cod, Salmon, Bass), Shellfish (Crab, Lobster, Shrimp), tree nuts (Almond, Cashew, Hazelnut, Macadamia nut, Pecan, Pine nut, Pistachio, Walnut ...), Gluten (Barley, Oats, Rye, Triticale). other-milk/-egg/-fish/-shellfish/-treenut take a free-text source. An empty object {} clears all allergens.

brand.description: Brand name, mainly to verify data.

food.description: true (default) for a food ingredient; false for a non-food item.

ingredient_list.description: Ingredient list text as it appears on a label, e.g. "Curlies (Milk, Sugar)".

measures.description: Custom units, e.g. [{quantity:1, unit:'cup', equivalent_quantity:240, equivalent_unit:'gram'}].

equivalent_quantity.description: How much of equivalent_unit that many units equal (e.g. 20).

equivalent_unit.description: gram, oz, lb, kg, or another measure's unit.

quantity.description: How many of `unit` the measure describes (e.g. 1).

unit.description: Name of the unit, e.g. "cookie" or "cup". Not gram, oz, lb or kg (every ingredient has those).

nutrients.description: Nutrition facts (food ingredients only). Amounts per serving (nutrition_quantity x nutrition_unit): calories; grams for protein, fat, fat_saturated, fat_trans, carbohydrate, fiber, uncounted_fiber, sugar, added_sugar, sugar_alcohol, fat_monounsaturated, fat_polyunsaturated, omega_3, omega_6, water, ash; milligrams for cholesterol, sodium, calcium, iron, potassium, vitamin_c, vitamin_e, thiamin, riboflavin, niacin, vitamin_b6, pantothenic_acid, phosphorus, magnesium, zinc, copper, manganese, chloride, choline; micrograms for vitamin_k, folate, vitamin_b12, biotin, iodine, selenium, chromium, molybdenum; IU for vitamin_d_IU and vitamin_a_IU. Required for a food ingredient: calories, protein, fat, fat_saturated, fat_trans, cholesterol, carbohydrate, fiber, sugar, added_sugar, sodium, calcium, iron, vitamin_a_IU, vitamin_c.

nutrition_quantity.description: Required for food ingredients: quantity of nutrition_unit the nutrients are for, e.g. 0.5 for 0.5 cup.

nutrition_unit.description: Required for food and safety ingredients. Food: the unit the nutrients are entered in (gram, oz, lb, kg, "100 grams", a unit from measures, or a volume unit such as cup once measures includes a volume). Safety: deg_f, deg_c, ph, brix, aw, seconds, minutes, hours, psi, ppm, percent, pass_fail or each.

source.description: Data source: URL, supplier or recipe id.

name: recipal_create_ingredient
title: Create ingredient

description: WRITE: add a price for an ingredient that becomes active on effective_at (the active cost is the one with the latest effective_at not after the date; one cost per ingredient per date). price and shipping are per quantity x unit. Changes the cost of every recipe using the ingredient from that date. Not allowed for subrecipe ingredients. POST /ingredient_costs.

effective_at.description: Date the cost becomes active, yyyy-mm-dd.

quantity.description: How much of the unit the price covers (default 0).

unit.description: A unit of the ingredient, e.g. "1 cup", "1 lb".

name: recipal_create_ingredient_cost
title: Add ingredient cost

description: WRITE: create a new, empty recipe (add ingredient lines with recipal_add_recipe_ingredient, or use recipal_create_recipe_from_ingredients to do both at once). All fields are optional. Creates a record in your ReciPal account; it counts against the plan's recipe allowance. POST /recipes.

allergens.description: Allergens by name, e.g. {"Milk": true, "Almond": true, "other-shellfish": "Oyster"}. Standard names: Wheat, Peanuts, Soy, Sesame, Mustard, Sulfites, Milk (Goat milk, Sheep milk), Egg (Duck egg, Quail egg), Fish (Tuna, Cod, Salmon, Bass), Shellfish (Crab, Lobster, Shrimp), tree nuts (Almond, Cashew, Hazelnut, Macadamia nut, Pecan, Pine nut, Pistachio, Walnut ...), Gluten (Barley, Oats, Rye, Triticale). other-milk/-egg/-fish/-shellfish/-treenut take a free-text source. An empty object {} clears all allergens.

ingredient_list.description: Ingredient list text for the label.

overhead_cost.description: Overhead cost per batch (rent, electricity, equipment ...).

package_yield_quantity.description: Net weight of each finished package, in package_yield_unit (default 0).

package_yield_unit.description: Unit of the finished package weight: "grams" (default), "ounces", "mL" or "fluid ounces".

packages.description: Number of packages the recipe yields per batch (0 or more).

packaging_cost.description: Cost per package of direct and secondary packaging.

prepared_serving_note.description: Note after the serving size on FDA labels, e.g. "makes 1 cup prepared".

subrecipe_name.description: Name shown when this recipe is used as a subrecipe in another recipe's ingredient list.

subrecipe_name_french.description: French name shown when used as a subrecipe.

suggested_serving.description: Suggested serving in common terms, e.g. "1 piece or 1 cup".

visual_unit_of_measure.description: Visual reference after the metric serving size on FDA labels, e.g. "5 chips".

name: recipal_create_recipe
title: Create recipe

description: WRITE: create a new recipe and its ingredient lines in one call. ingredients lists ingredient ids with the weight of each in grams. Optional yield, servings and packaging fields as in recipal_create_recipe. Creates a record in your ReciPal account. POST /recipes/shortcut.

allergens.description: Allergens by name, e.g. {"Milk": true, "Almond": true, "other-shellfish": "Oyster"}. An empty object {} clears all allergens.

ingredient_list.description: Ingredient list text for the label.

ingredients.description: Ingredient ids with their weights in grams (1-100 lines).

overhead_cost.description: Overhead cost per batch (rent, electricity, equipment ...).

package_yield_quantity.description: Net weight of each finished package, in package_yield_unit (default 0).

package_yield_unit.description: Unit of the finished package weight: "grams" (default), "ounces", "mL" or "fluid ounces".

packages.description: Number of packages the recipe yields per batch (0 or more).

packaging_cost.description: Cost per package of direct and secondary packaging.

prepared_serving_note.description: Note after the serving size on FDA labels, e.g. "makes 1 cup prepared".

subrecipe_name.description: Name shown when this recipe is used as a subrecipe in another recipe's ingredient list.

subrecipe_name_french.description: French name shown when used as a subrecipe.

suggested_serving.description: Suggested serving in common terms, e.g. "1 piece or 1 cup".

visual_unit_of_measure.description: Visual reference after the metric serving size on FDA labels, e.g. "5 chips".

name: recipal_create_recipe_from_ingredients
title: Create recipe with ingredients

description: WRITE: turn a recipe into an ingredient (a subrecipe) with its nutrition, costing and ingredient list, so it can be used inside other recipes. Later changes to the recipe flow through to the ingredient. Fails if the recipe is empty. Returns the new ingredient. POST /recipes/{id}/create_subrecipe.

recipe_id.description: Recipe to turn into a subrecipe.

name: recipal_create_subrecipe
title: Turn recipe into subrecipe

description: One finished-goods stock row by id. Needs an inventory plan. GET /finished_goods/{id}.
name: recipal_get_finished_good
title: Get finished goods row

description: One ingredient in full (yours or a public one): allergens, ingredient-list text, custom units, and every nutrient per 100 grams. GET /ingredients/{id}.
name: recipal_get_ingredient
title: Get ingredient

description: One ingredient cost entry by id. GET /ingredient_costs/{id}.
name: recipal_get_ingredient_cost
title: Get ingredient cost

description: One raw-material stock row by id (quantity, unit, weeks remaining, reorder guideline, on-hand value). Needs an inventory plan. GET /inventories/{id}.
name: recipal_get_inventory
title: Get raw-material inventory row

description: A recipe's saved nutrition-facts label settings (format, which rows show, styling) plus the computed nutrition claims (e.g. Fat Free) and ingredient list per language. The token is the last part of the recipe's primary_label path (/api/v1/labels/{token}). Optionally compute claims and ingredient list for another format. GET /labels/{token}.

label_token.description: Label token from the recipe's primary_label path.

result_format.description: Compute claims and ingredient list for this format instead of the saved one, e.g. legacy_fda/adult/vertical.

name: recipal_get_label
title: Get label

description: Status of a label render started with recipal_start_label_render: waiting, processing, ready or error. When ready, url is a temporary presigned download link. Poll about once a second; each poll counts toward the weekly request limit. GET /recipes/label_renders/{token}.
name: recipal_get_label_render_status
title: Get label render status

description: One recipe in full: yield, servings, packages, allergens, costs (ingredient + packaging/labor/overhead), ingredient list, tags, primary label path and the complete per-serving nutrition. GET /recipes/{id}.
name: recipal_get_recipe
title: Get recipe

description: One ingredient line of a recipe, including units_and_grams (the units you can use for it, each with its weight in grams). GET /recipes/{recipe_id}/recipe_ingredients/{id}.
name: recipal_get_recipe_ingredient
title: Get recipe ingredient

description: The currently active cost of every ingredient (one entry per ingredient): price, shipping, quantity and unit. GET /ingredient_costs.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

name: recipal_list_current_ingredient_costs
title: List current ingredient costs

description: Recipe tags in use with the number of recipes carrying each, most used first. Use them to filter recipal_list_finished_goods. Needs an inventory plan. GET /finished_goods/tags.
name: recipal_list_finished_good_tags
title: List recipe tags

description: Finished-goods stock rows: recipe, quantity on hand, unit, total packages, lot-code settings, case/pallet sizes and the on-hand value. Needs an inventory plan. GET /finished_goods.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

q.description: Case-insensitive search in the recipe name.

tags.description: Only rows whose recipe has ALL these tags.

name: recipal_list_finished_goods
title: List finished goods inventory

description: The cost history of one ingredient: effective date, quantity, unit, price and shipping per entry (the entry with the latest effective_at not in the future is the active one). GET /ingredients/{id}/ingredient_costs.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

name: recipal_list_ingredient_costs
title: List costs of an ingredient

description: List your own ingredients (custom and subrecipe ingredients) with allergens, units and headline nutrition per 100 g. Set full=true for every nutrient. Archived ones are hidden unless asked for. GET /ingredients.

full.description: Return every ingredient field including all nutrients (large). Default false.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

name: recipal_list_ingredients
title: List ingredients

description: Raw-material (ingredient) stock rows: quantity on hand, weeks remaining, daily consumption, quantity on order, reorder risk (safe, warning, critical), reorder level and the on-hand value. Needs an inventory plan (otherwise 403 INVENTORY_PLAN_REQUIRED). By default sorted by weeks remaining, lowest first. GET /inventories.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

q.description: Case-insensitive search in the ingredient name.

sort_direction.description: "asc" (default), "desc", or "mid" (warning band first, then critical, then safe; only for weeks_remaining and risk).

supplier_id.description: Only rows linked to this supplier.

tags.description: Only rows whose ingredient has ALL these tags.

name: recipal_list_inventories
title: List raw-material inventory

description: Ingredient tags in use with the number of ingredients carrying each, most used first. Use them to filter recipal_list_inventories. Needs an inventory plan. GET /inventories/tags.
name: recipal_list_inventory_tags
title: List ingredient tags

description: The formula of one recipe: every recipe ingredient line with ingredient id, name, quantity, unit, waste %, total grams and the display name per label language. Use the line ids with recipal_update_recipe_ingredient. GET /recipes/{id}/recipe_ingredients.
name: recipal_list_recipe_ingredients
title: List recipe ingredients

description: List your recipes (products) with yield, servings, cost per batch/package and the headline per-serving nutrition (calories, fat, sodium, carbohydrate, protein). Sorted by last update by default. Set full=true for the complete object with every nutrient. Pages of up to 20; a page with fewer rows is the last. GET /recipes.

full.description: Return every recipe field including all ~80 nutrients (large). Default false.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

name: recipal_list_recipes
title: List recipes

description: WRITE (destructive): permanently remove one ingredient line from a recipe. It cannot be undone, but the same ingredient can be added back (with recipal_add_recipe_ingredient). Changes the recipe's nutrition, label and cost. The ingredient itself is not deleted. DELETE /recipes/{recipe_id}/recipe_ingredients/{id}.
name: recipal_remove_recipe_ingredient
title: Remove ingredient from recipe

description: WRITE: create a NEW recipe as a copy of an existing one, with every ingredient quantity and the yield multiplied by scale_amount (1 = plain copy; per-serving nutrition stays the same; scaling down cannot take packages below 1). Costs and tags carry over. The original is not changed. Without a name the copy is called "<name> (copy)" or "<name> <n>x". POST /recipes/{id}/scale.
name: recipal_scale_recipe
title: Copy or scale recipe

description: WRITE (render job): start rendering a recipe's nutrition label as a PDF or PNG and return the render status with a token. Always asynchronous: poll recipal_get_label_render_status with the token until status is ready, then give the user the temporary download url. Each account may run 5 renders in parallel. GET /recipes/{id}/label.pdf|label.png?async=true.

page_size.description: PDF only: "auto" (default) crops to the label, or letter, legal, A4.

zoom.description: PNG only: scale from 0.8 to 6 (default 3); larger = crisper, bigger image.

name: recipal_start_label_render
title: Start label render

description: WRITE: change fields of one of YOUR ingredients (public ingredients cannot be edited); fields you leave out stay unchanged. If nutrition_unit, nutrition_quantity or their measure change, nutrients you do not pass are rescaled to keep the same amount per serving. measures REPLACES the whole list of custom units, so send them all. Setting archived true hides the ingredient from lists; false restores it. The change flows into every recipe using the ingredient. PUT /ingredients/{id}.

allergens.description: Allergens by name, e.g. {"Milk": true, "Almond": true, "other-shellfish": "Oyster"}. Standard names: Wheat, Peanuts, Soy, Sesame, Mustard, Sulfites, Milk (Goat milk, Sheep milk), Egg (Duck egg, Quail egg), Fish (Tuna, Cod, Salmon, Bass), Shellfish (Crab, Lobster, Shrimp), tree nuts (Almond, Cashew, Hazelnut, Macadamia nut, Pecan, Pine nut, Pistachio, Walnut ...), Gluten (Barley, Oats, Rye, Triticale). other-milk/-egg/-fish/-shellfish/-treenut take a free-text source. archived.description: true to archive, false to restore.

measures.description: The FULL list of custom units (replaces the existing list).

equivalent_quantity.description: How much of equivalent_unit that many units equal (e.g. 20).

quantity.description: How many of `unit` the measure describes (e.g. 1).

unit.description: Name of the unit, e.g. "cookie" or "cup". Not gram, oz, lb or kg (every ingredient has those).

nutrients.description: Nutrition facts to change; others are kept. nutrition_quantity.description: Quantity of nutrition_unit the nutrients are for.

nutrition_unit.description: Unit the nutrients are entered in.

name: recipal_update_ingredient
title: Update ingredient

description: WRITE: change an existing ingredient cost entry (date, unit, quantity, price, shipping); fields you leave out stay unchanged. Changes recipe costs that depend on it. Not allowed for subrecipe ingredients. PUT /ingredient_costs/{id}.

effective_at.description: New effective date, yyyy-mm-dd (unique per ingredient).

quantity.description: How much of the unit the price covers.

name: recipal_update_ingredient_cost
title: Update ingredient cost

description: WRITE: change fields of one recipe; fields you leave out stay unchanged. package_yield_quantity "default" sets the package weight to the total weight of the current ingredients (no moisture loss accounted for); ingredient_list "default" rebuilds the label ingredient list in descending weight order. Changes labels and costs of this recipe. Tags cannot be set here. PUT /recipes/{id}.

ingredient_list.description: Ingredient list text for the label, or "default" to rebuild it from the ingredients.

overhead_cost.description: Overhead cost per batch (rent, electricity, equipment ...).

package_yield_quantity.description: Net weight of each finished package in package_yield_unit, or "default" to total the ingredient weights.

package_yield_unit.description: Unit of the finished package weight: "grams" (default), "ounces", "mL" or "fluid ounces".

packages.description: Number of packages the recipe yields per batch (0 or more).

packaging_cost.description: Cost per package of direct and secondary packaging.

prepared_serving_note.description: Note after the serving size on FDA labels, e.g. "makes 1 cup prepared".

subrecipe_name.description: Name shown when this recipe is used as a subrecipe in another recipe's ingredient list.

subrecipe_name_french.description: French name shown when used as a subrecipe.

suggested_serving.description: Suggested serving in common terms, e.g. "1 piece or 1 cup".

visual_unit_of_measure.description: Visual reference after the metric serving size on FDA labels, e.g. "5 chips".

name: recipal_update_recipe
title: Update recipe

description: WRITE: change the AMOUNT of one ingredient line in a recipe (unit, quantity, waste or total_grams; total_grams overrides unit and quantity). It cannot swap the ingredient: remove the line and add another instead. Changes the recipe's nutrition, label and cost. PUT /recipes/{recipe_id}/recipe_ingredients/{id}.

total_grams.description: Weight in grams; overrides unit and quantity.

unit.description: Unit, one of the ingredient's units.

name: recipal_update_recipe_ingredient
